messages.subject: Project Tempest — disclosure letter draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Nina,

Attached is the draft disclosure letter for your review. Please check the specific disclosures carefully — particularly the patent observation, the Northstar correspondence, the Wexbourne 90-day termination right, the HMRC R&D enquiry, and the Clydesford facility (£500k, £180k drawn). It's important these are fairly disclosed to protect you against warranty claims.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
